To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the language political (LP)-related agency of Estonian-speaker families in Finland is affected by the transnational relations of the speakers, and the LP practices and ideologies of the speakers are affected by the translocal relations of the speakers.
Estonian-speaker families’ LP practices and ideologies are affected by the Finnish state language policy and by their transnational relations.

the Estonian-speaking community in Helsinki is a relatively homogenous group, which is characterized by a high level of transnational relations with Estonia, and which is actively engaged in LP in order to preserve and promote the use of the Estonian language among their children.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how Estonian-speaking families in Finland make choices in their everyday lives which may be seen as a form of LP.

the ways in which the emergent transnational Estonian-Finn space affects Estonian-speakersʼ language management, language ideologies and language practices in the Finnish context, and the ways in which Estonian-speakers in Finland contribute to the emergence of the Estonian-Finn transnational space.
LP agency in transnational space and the interplay between language practices and language policies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Estonian-speakerʼs LP is a multi-sited process that takes place in different sites and is influenced by different actors.
the Estonian-speaking community in Finland has a potential to become a significant actor in the language political field in Estonia.
the LP practices of Estonian-speaker families in Helsinki are situated in the transnational context and are influenced by the state language policies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Estonian language is a political agent, which is used in a political struggle between the state and the Estonian-speaking diaspora in Finland.
the LP of Estonian speakers in Finland should be seen in the context of transnational Estonian-Finnian relations.
the Estonian-speaking community is not only a part of the Finnish society but also an integral part of the Estonian transnational space.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transnational space of Estonian–Finneness should be taken into account in the study of language political agency of speakers of Estonian in Finland.
LP agency is an emergent process, which is situated in a specific sociocultural context and involves different actors.
the language political agency of Estonians in Finland should be analyzed in the context of Estonian–Finnen transnational relations.
